title: a comparative study of factors affecting family well-being of single-father and single-mother families
core_idea: To compare family well-being between single-father and single-mother households and identify how demographic, familial, environmental, and work-life factors influence family well-being among parents of children aged 0–12.
tldr: Comparative study examining family well-being in single-father versus single-mother families (children 0–12), analyzing demographic, familial, environmental, and work-life influences using questionnaires and statistical methods on a sample of single parents recruited through online platforms, service centers, and community networks.
